description: Deliver stored old campaign grants into a new real campaign before any current grant, then release current grants and observe leadership with an independent term-qualified ledger.

harness.description: TestAssuranceDelayedElectionGrants; actual Bootstrap, two Campaign calls, FIFO storage, genuine captured replies and fixed release schedule.
semantic_changes: MemoryStorage replaces durable media in a no-crash model.
A deterministic transport holds actual VoteResp messages; local work remains reliable FIFO.
Public BasicStatus supplies the measured role and term. Driver counters derive only from delivered message identities.

legality.derivation: Bootstrap three RawNodes with the same peers and drain actual configuration application. Campaign node 1, process actual outgoing vote requests and FIFO storage work, but capture every actual VoteResp to node 1 instead of delivering it. At capture verify the producer MemoryStorage HardState has the response term and vote for node 1. Repeat Campaign on the still-candidate node and collect its next term self/remote replies identically. No vote requests or replies are constructed by the driver. Release old self, old peer 2, old peer 3, current self, current peer 2 and current peer 3 in fixed order, draining ordinary output after each. Local completion responses are never delayed by this transport filter. All work terminates by permitted-work exhaustion or a construction bound, not by waiting for the property. No critical protocol fields are assigned.
legality.applicability: The repeated public Campaign call is handled by hup while candidate and calls becomeCandidate, which increments term and resets context. No Tick is required. Held network vote responses are independent of already completed local storage work.
alternatives: The earlier campaign never acquires authority because none of its grants is delivered before the second Campaign.
MemoryStorage observations at capture retain historical vote completion even after later HardState moves to the next term.

grounding.derivation: The driver maintains an independent sender set from the original delivered VoteResp messages whose Term equals the second actual campaign term and Reject is false. It does not inspect ProgressTracker.Votes or TallyVotes. Public BasicStatus supplies the leader role and actual term after each completed fixed phase. Compare leader implies current_majority. Raw counts, sender IDs, release identity, actual term and held reply count remain diagnostic; no observation is filtered on its expected outcome.
grounding.applicability: Each vote_phase_admitted and election_observed pair shares request/phase/node/campaign_term identity. The prerequisite denotes completed two-campaign construction and admission of a fixed release operation. Every phase drains and emits one result. Current-majority is necessary, not an equality or liveness assertion.
alternatives: Old-term delivery can leave the candidate pending without a violation.
The current self-plus-peer phase is a permitted completion control.

observable_properties.description: At each fixed completed phase, leadership requires delivered current-term grants from at least two of the three voters; lower-term grants do not contribute.

uncertainties: Only two consecutive non-pre-vote campaigns with fixed membership and six release checkpoints are covered.
No crash, competing leader or client-visible endpoint is observed.
